Data from ROSMAP are available through the Rush AD Center Resource Sharing Hub (https://www.radc.rush.edu). All the summary statistics are available in the supplementary tables. Metabolomics data and pre-processed data are accessible through the AD Knowledge Portal (https://adknowledgeportal.synapse.org/).
